jobs.description:
As a Field Service Panel Builder Technician, you will work on a variety of electrical installations at customer sites throughout the Netherlands. Your responsibilities include assembling, installing, connecting, commissioning and maintaining electrical distribution systems and control panels. You will work both on-site with customers and in the workshop. At customer locations, you ensure that electrical installations are installed safely, correctly and according to specifications. You will also troubleshoot electrical faults, identify the root cause of problems and provide effective solutions to get the customer's installation back up and running as quickly as possible. Your work is both electrical and mechanical, making this a varied and hands-on position. You will build cabinets based on electrical schematics, connect electrical installations and, when required, interconnect panels on-site when they cannot be transported as a single unit. You will also have direct contact with customers and coordinate your activities with them to ensure that installation and service work causes as little disruption to their operations as possible. During periods with less field service work, you will support the workshop team by building electrical panels based on technical drawings and schematics. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A varied technical position combining field service, panel building and electrical installation. Work at different customer locations throughout the Netherlands. A high level of independence and responsibility in your daily work. Opportunities to develop your technical skills through relevant training and education. The opportunity to obtain additional certifications such as VCA and NEN 3140. A combination of workshop-based and customer-facing work. Participation in on-call and breakdown services. 25 vacation days and 13 ADV days Wat levert deze baan jou op? A lot of variety. You will not be doing the same thing every day. You will work at different customer locatio

and deal with different electrical installations and technical challenges. Hands-on technical work. You will work directly with electrical distribution systems, control panels and electrical installations, allowing you to put your practical skills to use every day. Independence and responsibility. You will have the freedom to investigate technical problems, determine the best solution and carry out your work independently. Technical challenge. The combination of electrical and mechanical work makes this a broad and challenging position where you will continuously encounter different technical situations. Room to develop. You will have the opportunity to follow relevant courses and training and further develop your career within electrical engineering, panel building and service. Functie-eisen MBO level 3 working and thinking level, preferably in Electrical Engineering, or demonstrable relevant work experience. A solid background in electrical engineering and electrical installations. Experience in panel building is highly preferred. Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and technical drawings. Experience with electrical distribution systems and/or control panels is an advantage. Strong practical and technical skills. Able to analyse technical problems and troubleshoot faults independently. Accurate, safety-conscious and responsible in your work. Willingness to follow relevant technical training and education. Familiarity with NEN 3140 procedures or willingness to obtain the relevant training. VCA certificate or willingness to obtain one. Valid driving licence (Category B). Flexible regarding working hours and willing to participate in on-call/breakdown services. Willingness to travel throughout the Netherlands and occasionally work away from home during the day. Good command of English. Dutch is an advantage, but not a requirement. Hier kom je te werken You will join a growing Dutch technical organisation specialising in electrical distribution

Soldering operator

Working as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.

As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.

Your tasks are, amongst others:

· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings

· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series

· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards

· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspection

You will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.

What Benchmark has to offer to you:

· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.

· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.

· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.

· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.

· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.

· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.

What do we ask of you?

· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.

· Being able to work very precise and accurate.

· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.

· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.

About Benchmark:

Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. These products are supplied from product design to volume production and sometimes directly to the end user. This entire process, from design to production, is carried out entirely in Almelo.

Globally, Benchmark Electronics Inc. currently has 23 locations. In Almelo, the Netherlands, you will be working with up to 750 colleagues.
